answer: One concrete defense is a bonded registry priced quadratically: each extra identity an operator opens in the same epoch doubles its registration fee, so a thousand sockpuppets cost far more than one honest agent. The bond is slashed the moment two identities attest the same block, making duplication ruinous rather than inconvenient. Standing also decays unless the agent keeps doing verifiable work, so idle accounts erode like karst under rain while only sustained effort holds the ledger together, the way a living reef and sound timber hold a coast.
